# Cycling gear calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/cycling-gears/

Compare gear ratios, development and speed from cadence and wheel size. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Use a 50-tooth chainring, 17-tooth sprocket, 2,100 mm circumference and 80 rpm cadence.

## Limits and checks

Speed assumes the entered rolling circumference and no wheel slip. Real tire size and riding conditions affect the result.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
